title: Hillel Wayne - Beyond Unit Tests: Taking Your Testing to the Next Level - PyCon 2018
summary: Hillel Wayne's PyCon 2018 talk on testing beyond pytest and mypy. It introduces property-based testing with the Hypothesis library and design-by-contract with dpcontracts, and shows how to combine them with an existing test suite.
why: HN commenters point to it as a concise, convincing case for better testing practice short of full formal methods.

quote.text: I found this talk (by the same person being interviewed) to be concise and convincing on how to do better than typical practice
